cemu.blockers: {n} pack(s) that stop the game from ever finishing loading
cemu.clean: Nothing to fix: no pack can stop the loading.
cemu.default.fixed: {n} pack(s) disabled: {list}. They stay installed, but Cemu will no longer activate them by itself.
cemu.default.pack: STILL-ACTIVE PACK: {n} has "default = true" in its rules.txt, so Cemu activates it even though it is no longer in settings.xml. This pack overwrites game files. "botw fix" disables it.
cemu.deploy.extra_files: Cemu has {a} files for {b} merged: files from an earlier merge are left over. The game finds everything it needs, this is not blocking.
cemu.deploy.missing: the active profile '{p}' has never been merged
cemu.deploy.missing_files: merged files are missing in Cemu: {a} deployed for {b} merged - rerun the deploy
cemu.deploy.ok: the active profile is fully merged and deployed ({n} files)
cemu.fix_first: Remove the blocking packs and start anyway?
cemu.howto: The game must be closed before running this.
cemu.mode.keep: keep the cosmetic packs too (draw distance, FPS++, shaders)
cemu.mode.nocheat: minimal (only the UKMM pack, cheats off)
cemu.mode.safe: safe (keep only the UKMM pack and the cheats)
cemu.open: Cemu is open: it rewrites settings.xml on exit, so the change would be lost. Close it, then run again.
cemu.optional: {n} cosmetic pack(s) sharing the mods' scope (harmless, but switched off by default)
cemu.preset.bad: INCOMPATIBLE SETTING: "{a}" ({c}) needs the Extended Memory pack, which cannot run alongside mods. Weapons and attached actors will vanish. "botw fix" sets "{b}".
cemu.preset.fixed: {n} setting(s) set to a compatible value: {list}
cemu.preset.ok: No graphic pack setting depends on a missing pack.
cemu.save.here: a save is present ({n} files): load it only with the profile it was created with
cemu.save.mismatch: THE SAVE WAS MADE WITH '{a}' BUT '{b}' IS ACTIVE: loading it will hang forever
cemu.save.none: no save in the slot: Cemu will offer a new game (that always works)
cemu.save.unknown: the save is older than every deployment: we cannot tell which mods made it. If it refuses to load, use 'botw newgame'
cemu.title: What Cemu loads at startup
cemu.ukmm.missing: the UKMM pack is NOT active - the game will start vanilla
cemu.why_extended: Extended Memory remaps +2 GB and needs the game recompiled; UKMM replaces game files, so the two together make loading never finish
cemu.why_hdmap: a file-replacement pack, which UKMM's own rules.txt forbids alongside another mod loader
cli.description: Everything around Breath of the Wild on Cemu: mods, profiles, saves, co-op.
cli.epilog:
Without a command, botw opens a menu. The language is your system's.
Examples:  botw deploy sur          botw catalog sur --deploy
          botw mods search wind    botw newgame
cli.help.activate: remember this profile as the default
cli.help.build: build a profile by answering a few questions
cli.help.catalog: recreate a tested mod combination as a profile
cli.help.check: will the game start? lists what blocks the loading
cli.help.checklong: Reads the active profile, the deployed pack and every graphic pack Cemu will load, and names the things that make the game hang on the loading screen. Changes nothing.
cli.help.coop: two players on the same world
cli.help.cosmetics: keep the cosmetic packs (draw distance, FPS, shaders)
cli.help.fix: fix the loading problem: remove the blocking packs, redeploy
cli.help.graphicslong: Turn Cemu's own graphic packs back on: resolution, anti-aliasing, and the Clarity colour-correction preset. The packs that cause the endless loading are always removed.
cli.help.graphicsmods: also re-enable the third-party mods (DrawDistance, FPS++, DivineLaserBeam): they change the look more than the official ones
cli.help.graphicsrestore: take the pack settings, presets included, from an older settings.xml. Packs that block the loading are never restored.
cli.help.installmods: install a mod from a file or a link
cli.help.installmods.profile: profile that receives the mod (default: active profile)
cli.help.installmods.source: .zip path, or a link to a .zip
cli.help.jeu: switch mod set AND save together
cli.help.jeulancer: launch Cemu right after the switch
cli.help.jeulong: Archives the current save, deploys the requested profile, then restores that profile's save. The save you are playing is never deleted: it is put aside, tagged with the profile that can load it.
cli.help.langcode: language code (en, fr) or 'auto' to follow the system again
cli.help.langone: use this language for this run only (en, fr)
cli.help.mods: list, search, download and install mods
cli.help.newgame: start a new game without losing the current one
cli.help.profile: list / show / use / create / delete / verify profiles
cli.help.tools: install and check UKMM, BCML, Cemu
config.title: Settings
coop.cemu_open: Cemu is open: close it, it rewrites settings.xml on exit.
coop.enable_hint: Turn it on with: botw coop enable
coop.pad.missing: PadChannels tag not found in settings.xml (unexpected Cemu version?)
coop.radmin.firewall: Windows Firewall blocks private networks by default; allow Cemu on private networks.
coop.radmin.missing: Radmin VPN not detected on this machine.
coop.radmin.not_connected: Radmin VPN is installed but not connected.
coop.radmin.step1: Install Radmin VPN on both PCs and create a network with the same name.
coop.radmin.step2: Both players must be on that network; check the address shown by 'botw coop radmin'.
coop.radmin.step3: Same game version, same mods, same profile on both machines ('botw profile show').
coop.radmin.step4: Player 2 starts Cemu, opens the game, presses + on his controller.
coop.radmin.step5: Player 1 does the same; BOTW finds the session on the local network.
coop.radmin.title: Two players over the network
